title: fix(spec)!: a builtin config value carrying a {token} is judged for its type at the build doors (#23260)
body:
Fixes #23260
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

The build doors' value arm (`flowNodeConfigRefusals` in `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-node-config-refusals.ts`) judged a builtin node's present config value against its executor contract, except a value carrying a `{token}`: `builtinValueJudged` returned false when `carriesInterpolationToken` found one, because "only the interpolation decides what the run will see there". #19939 deleted the flow interpolator and every call site it had, and every builtin executor parses its config as authored (an `http` node after its credential channel's `signingSecret`). So every value the carve-out admitted was refused at every run that reached the node. This PR deletes the carve-out:

- **A token-carrying value is judged for its type like any literal.** `get_record` with `limit: '{x}'` is refused at `nodes.N.config.limit` ("expected number, received string") by `FlowSchema.parse`, `defineStack` (`STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`, 422, at `flows.N.nodes.M.config.limit`), `objectstack validate`, the save door and `AutomationEngine.registerFlow`.
- **The value-slot and text-slot judges keep their own located token refusals, and the arm exempts them explicitly.** It asks the two judges which paths they refuse (`slotJudgeRefusedPaths`: `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`, and `textSlotTemplateRefusal` over `flowNodeTextSlotSources`) and skips a contract issue at one of those paths. A token at a value or text slot is therefore reported once, by its judge, with its label and remedy. The judges are asked, not re-read: no second copy of the dialect's grammar.
- **A literal read as written keeps its own words.** At a key whose contract issue is marked `READ_AS_WRITTEN_PARAM` (a `notify` `sourceObject` / `actorId` / `payload`, an `http` `method` / `durable` / `timeoutMs` / whole `headers` map), the marked issue speaks for the key. With the carve-out gone, the contract's type issue beside it (`timeoutMs: '{t}'` is also not a number) would otherwise reach the arm first and replace the literal's remedy. The key is refused once, as before.
- **The rationale says what holds.** It is corrected in five places: the `READ_AS_WRITTEN_PARAM` docblock (`flow-template-token.ts`), the value arm's docblocks, the `FlowSchema` comment that restates the arm, the step-18 D3 entry `flow-builtin-node-config-values-refused`, and its rationale fragment in `registry.ts.template`.

`carriesInterpolationToken` and `INTERPOLATION_TOKEN` are deleted: nothing else read them, and neither was exported. `check:api-surface` reads "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged".

## Measured first (the dispatch's four assumptions)

- **A1, nothing interpolates any more: HOLDS.** At base `175e8d414`, `service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts` exports only `VariableMap`, `FlowTextTemplateError`, `textTemplateScope` and `renderTextSlot`. The deleted interpolator survives only in comments. Every contract-carrying executor calls `parseNodeConfig(type, id, Schema, node.config)` on the authored config: crud x4, `http` (on `{ ...authored, signingSecret: held }`), `loop` (with a `body`), `map`, `notify`, `parallel`, `screen`, `script`, `subflow` and `try_catch`. Text slots are rendered and value-slot envelopes evaluated only after the parse. Searching `service-automation/src` and `spec/src/automation` for `interpolate`, `interpolateString` and `resolveToken` finds no code caller.
- **A2, the build doors share the one judge: HOLDS, and both are pinned.** `FlowSchema`'s superRefine calls `flowNodeConfigRefusals` (`flow.zod.ts`). `defineStack` parses `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`, whose `flows` are `FlowSchema`. `registerFlow` parses first, in `canonicalizeStoredFlow`. Pins: `defineStack` in the spec test, `registerFlow` in `service-automation`'s `config-parse.test.ts`.
- **A3, the double-report risk: HOLDS, with one addition.** A throwaway probe at base (39 configs, deleted after the run) measured one token at each kind of slot. At a value slot, the contract raised one issue at the slot path: a `custom` issue with the value-slot judge's message, or at a `loop` / `map` `collection` an `invalid_union` carrying the same message. The value-slot judge refused the same path, and the base arm reported nothing. Text slots measured the same way with the text-slot judge (a single brace, or a `{{ $User.Id }}` hole). Without the exemption, the arm adds `node-config-refused-by-contract` at that same path (ablation A2 below). **The addition:** at the `http` literal keys, the contract also raises a type issue beside the `READ_AS_WRITTEN_PARAM` one. Only the carve-out had kept that type issue from reaching the arm first, so the arm now prefers the marked issue (ablation A3).
- **A4, lint and docs: HOLDS.** No rule in `packages/lint/src` restates the carve-out: the lint calls `flowNodeConfigRefusals`. A grep of `content/docs`, `skills` and `docs` for a token at a typed key finds nothing. Control: the same pattern finds the spec test's `limit: '{page.size}'`. The only hits are release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` entries, including `@objectstack/spec`'s `18.0.0-next.0` entry describing the carve-out. They are not edited here; the changeset carries the FROM → TO.

**At the doors, after the change** (throwaway probes through the shipped `AutomationEngine.registerFlow` and `@objectstack/lint` `validateStackExpressions`, on a rebuilt `dist` at `f88ed85f6`):

- The probe is refused at `config.limit`.
- `limit: 10` registers.
- Each token at a value slot (`fields.title`, `collection`, `recordId`) and at a text slot (`notify` `title`, `http` `url`) draws exactly one finding, the slot judge's located one.
- `http` `timeoutMs: '{t}'` draws one finding, in the literal's words.

**Who is affected.** The census was a TS-AST pass. It statically evaluated every builtin node literal's `config` in `examples/`, `packages/` and `apps/` at base, plus hotcrm at `0f84c9c`: 1010 nodes, 244 of them carrying a `{…}` token, 266 partly dynamic. It compared the base arm with the new one and found 0 verdict changes. Control: a synthetic `get_record` with `limit: '{x}'` moves.

## Tests (at `f88ed85f6`, the head this PR opens on)

- `@objectstack/spec`, the whole `local` project in four locked runs: `src/automation` + `src/migrations` 40 files / 1769 tests; `src/ui src/ai src/security src/integration src/identity src/marketplace src/studio src/qa src/meta-spelling` 170 / 5824; `src/data src/kernel src/conversions` 191 / 5691 (+1 todo); `src/system src/api src/contracts src/shared scripts` + the root files 268 / 6998. All passed. `repo` project: `scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` 1 / 9 passed.
- `@objectstack/spec` `typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck` all pass, and the test layer is held in its debt ledger.
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: 185 files / 2450 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/lint`: 138 files / 6683 tests passed.
- New pins in `flow-builtin-node-config-values.test.ts`:
  - the probe, at `nodes.1.config.limit`, in the contract's words;
  - the probe through `defineStack`, in the ADR-0112 envelope;
  - a literal of the right type, unchanged;
  - every spelling (`{x}`, `{{ x }}`, `${x}`) at seven typed keys;
  - one token at each of six value slots, reported once, by the value-slot judge;
  - one token at each of six text slots, reported once, by the text-slot judge;
  - `http` `timeoutMs` and whole `headers`, refused once, in the literal's words.
  
  The old CONTROL "a token value in a typed slot is never refused for its pre-interpolation type" is removed: it pinned the carve-out.
- New pin in `config-parse.test.ts`: `get_record` `limit: '{x}'` is refused at registration (`refused at \`limit\` by the get_record contract`) and at the run (`config.limit`), and `limit: 10` registers.

## The negative control and two ablations (one-time proofs, not committed)

Each leg ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode under `os-verify-lock`. Each anchor's count dropped and the blob changed. A shell trap restored by absolute path, and each restore was proved: blob equals HEAD `7199602764fe`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No `dist` leg was needed, because the spec pins import the source by relative path.

- **A1, the carve-out restored (the negative control).** Expected: the probe pins go red. Observed: 3 failed / 52 passed: the probe, the `defineStack` probe, and the every-spelling pin. ⚠ The first A1 attempt was an **empty operation**: its replacement carried its own anchor, so the anchor count stayed 1 → 1, and the tool refused before running the test. It was re-run with a two-line anchor, and the marker count on disk read 1.
- **A2, the slot-judge exemption deleted.** 4 failed / 51 passed: both "reported once" pins, plus the existing CONTROLs "a slot another judge owns is not re-judged here" and "a token-free sibling does not shield a refused value".
- **A3, the read-as-written preference deleted.** 1 failed / 54 passed: the literal's-words pin.
- **Control, the restored tree:** 55 / 55 passed.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `f88ed85f6` derived 90 commands. Every one was run, with its exit code captured before any pipe: 89 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs every package's `dist`, and this tree built only the `service-automation` and `lint` closures), so it is NOT MEASURED. Reconcile: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 89 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reads "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", and the build changed no tracked file. `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts `not-required (already-registered flow-builtin-node-config-values-refused)`.

The tree is 4 commits behind `origin/main` `404fc477e`. None of those commits touches a file this diff touches, but three files the derivation reads changed there: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, its self-test, and `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs`. CI's merge-ref run is the reading on current `main`.

ESLint, as a measured narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 changed files. The config ignores two of them (the changeset and `registry.ts.template`, per eslint's own JSON). It linted the other 6 with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## File surface

The claim's surface, plus three files that restate the arm's rationale. Leaving them would publish a sentence this change makes false:

- `flow.zod.ts`: one comment;
- `migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-builtin-node-config-values-refused.ts`: the D3 entry's `surface`, `replacement`, `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria`;
- `migrations/registry.ts.template`: the step-18 fragment, order 85.

Both registry files feed the generated upgrade guide, which is gitignored, so nothing generated is committed. The PR also adds one pin to `service-automation`'s `config-parse.test.ts`, the `registerFlow` door the dispatch asked to pin. No consumer fixture asserted the old carve-out: the census found 0 moved verdicts, and the only test that pinned it was the spec CONTROL above.

## Acceptance notes

- **A co-located type issue at a slot its judge refuses keeps the judge's verdict first.** Measured once: a `screen` `title` written as a `{ dialect: 'template', source: 'Hi {name}' }` envelope. The contract types it as a string, and the text-slot judge refuses the token. The arm exempts the path, as the carve-out did. The type refusal appears once the token is fixed.
- **One more rule finding now reaches the arm.** A token used to hide it: a `notify` `templateData` with no `template` (its rule refuses that whatever the values hold).
- **The changeset's level.** It is `minor`, following the convention #21898's own changeset used for this arm's accept-set narrowing. The line is `18.0.0-next.*` in pre mode.
